privacy: Focus history is stored locally in `data/productivity.db` (SQLite).
Friends, parties, chat, profile photos and other sharing features use the Pips online service when you enable/use them. Automatic update checks also contact the official download site.
The optional coach LLM and MAAS gateway are used only if configured/enabled. MAAS is off by default in public builds. Keep private configuration private.
The tracker never counts the widget itself as usage, and never counts idle/AFK time toward an app.
